newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia signs A$56 mln Siemens deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia signs A$56 mln Siemens deal.

text.p: The Australian government on Wednesday signed a A$56 million order with Siemens Plessey Electronic Systems Pty Ltd for 4,600 very high frequency combat radios for the Australia defence force, Defence Industry Minister Bronwyn Bishop said in a statement.
Seimens' selection as preferred tenderer, subject to contract negotiation, was announced in June, when the deal was valued at A$40 million.
"Delivery of the new radios, which will replace radios that came into service in the 1960s, is expected to begin late next year," Bishop said. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
